verdict.rationale: Convertio's developer docs list "Official Wrappers" with a PHP library on GitHub, so the vendor ships at least one first-party client library. The evidence names only PHP and invites users to "improve and modify them", which leaves breadth, versioning and active vendor maintenance unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of official libraries for other mainstream languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, Java), versioned releases, ongoing vendor maintenance, independent corroboration.
